text:
sanjay: kicking off account + vpc priming for the new eu9 GPU cluster. need a checklist: cloud project naming, CIDR ranges, quota requests, and handoff steps. target live date ~2w.

jamie: +1. which cloud/provider?

sanjay: GCP — project will be redwood-eu9-inference-prod (for now); we'll mirror the naming convention from eu3.

marta: CIDR note: avoid overlapping with existing shared VPCs. suggest reserving a /20 (4096 IPs) for the VPC: 10.88.0.0/20, split into three subnets (control, workloads, mgmt) each /22. keeps room for nodepools and future services.

lee: FYI GPUs in eu9 have limited A100 quota. need to file quota increases for: "A100 80GB GPUs" and "Preemptible GPUs" if we want burst lanes. Jamie — can you take the quota ticket?

jamie: on it. I'll open a support case and also flag sales for reserved capacity pricing. ETA to approval usually 48–72h but may take longer for new regions.

sanjay: also need networking: shared VPC peering to hub project, cloud router + NAT, and ILB for internal control plane. Firewall: allow node <-> metadata, control plane ports, and SSH from bastion only.

marta: add routes for pod CIDR mapping and secondary ranges for pods/services. Terraform snippet we used last time: 
```hcl
resource "google_compute_network" "vpc" {
  name = "redwood-eu9-vpc"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "workloads" {
  name = "eu9-workloads"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.88.4.0/22"
  region = "europe-west9"
  network = google_compute_network.vpc.id
  secondary_ip_range {
    range_name = "pods"
    ip_cidr_range = "10.92.0.0/16"
  }
}
```

lee: thanks. make sure to include KMS key policy in the project onboarding doc — private deployments will need CMK access. Also enable VPC Flow Logs for the workloads subnet.

jamie: quota ticket opened: CASE-98431. requested 8 A100-80GB and 20 preemptible A100s. added justification: "inference service for Redwood Dedicated pilot". attached expected monthly GPU hours and cost projection.

sanjay: cost quick math from finance: baseline (8 x A100 reserved) ~ $24k/mo compute, + network and infra ~ $3k. add 20 preemptible for burst: ~ $6k. tagging required for chargeback.

marta: security checklist: service account least privilege, VPC peering restricted to hub CIDR whitelist, no external IPs on nodes, image vulnerability scanning enabled on registries.

lee: handoff steps to runbook owner: 1) confirm quota approvals 2) Terraform apply in staging project 3) smoke test with kubelet + small model (gpt-small) 4) perf test (latency and throughput) 5) cost baseline captured 6) canary traffic + rollback plan.

sanjay: I'm drafting the runbook; will include commands for quota escalation and a rollback snippet. pinging @jamie when the quota case updates.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by jamie:infra — project-setup/gcp/eu9 — status: queued.

jamie: deploy-bot shows queued while support case pending. once quota is in place I'll run the Terraform apply.

lee: small operational gotcha — GCE node image we use in other regions has a startup-script that mounts persistent caches. ensure the startup-script is validated for eu9 zones (disk naming).

marta: DNS: create internal DNS zone redwood.internal and add A records for control-plane ILB; add SRV records for etcd if we use non-standard ports.

sanjay: testing checklist (short): 
- project IAM: owners/security review done
- VPC created + subnets
- peering to hub established
- firewall rules applied
- KMS key ready + IAM binding
- GKE/instance templates created
- small GPU nodepool provisioned (1 node)
- run gpu-smoke.sh and capture logs

jamie: update: support case moved to "in progress" with estimator asking for expected sustained hours. submitted chart. reaction :thumbsup:.

lee: once quota is approved we'll request a quota carve (if possible) to avoid noisy neighbors at start. coordinate with cloud rep.

marta: when you do terraform apply, use `-target=google_compute_network.vpc` first, then subnets, then firewall, then nodepools. minimizes blast radius.

sanjay: final question — who signs the handoff doc? we will need infra owner + prod-eng sign-off before scheduled cutover.

jamie: I'll own infra sign-off. pinging @marta for networking sign-off and @lee for runtime ops.

marta: I can sign once peering and firewall validated.

lee: I'll take runtime sign-off after perf tests and canary.

sanjay: great — I'll post the runbook draft in this thread when ready. thanks all.

deploy-bot: support-case CASE-98431 updated: quota estimator requested monthly sustained GPU hours.

jamie: noted, submitted estimate. next update when support approves or asks for more info.

sanjay: (post-run) follow-up items logged in the runbook: add automated cost alerts, add prometheus alerts for GPU OOM and Node GPU health, and schedule a 1-week post-mortem after cutover.

lee: ack. :white_check_mark:
